svg.title: Three instructions applied to a small 8x8 light grid
svg.desc: turn on 0,0 through 4,4, then toggle 2,2 through 6,6, then turn off 3,0 through 4,7. Part 1 treats each light as on or off and ends with 24 lights on. Part 2 treats each light as a brightness and ends with a total brightness of 61.

g.text: A tiny 8×8 version of the 1000×1000 grid
